caption: The drawing depicts a single rusty metal object placed on a plain, light beige background. The object has a long, rectangular body, brownish in hue with visible texture and signs of age or corrosion. Attached to one end are two curved prongs that branch out symmetrically, and between them are two shorter, flat extensions that project at angles. The drawing is rendered with attention to the texture and coloration of the metal, showing variations of brown, gray, and hints of reddish tones indicative of rust. The overall composition is centered, with the object positioned diagonally from the lower right to the upper left corner of the image. There are no additional elements or objects present in the drawing.
title: Bootjack
